title: Design, synthesis, and molecular docking of VO(II)-chitosan Schiff base nanoparticles for targeted colon cancer, antidiabetic, and antimicrobial applications.
authors: Ismail, Khaled M; Behzad, Mahdi; Ghasemi, Liana; Hassan, Safaa S
one_liner_zh: 该研究设计合成VO(II)-壳聚糖席夫碱纳米颗粒并用于抗癌、抗糖尿病和抗菌，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白（GLUT/α-淀粉酶），非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: In our continued investigation into the glucose recognition binding site of GLUT and to improve the efficacy of targeted anticancer agents, glycogenated metal complexes have demonstrated potential for treating colon cancer via the salicylaldehyde-d-glucose moiety. Chitosan, a biopolymer, serves as a source of the glucose moiety. A Schiff base (CSSA) was synthesized from the condensation reaction between chitosan (CS) and salicylaldehyde (SA), followed by the formation of the vanadyl complex [VO (CSSA)(2)]‧5H(2)O. Both compounds serve as a core for targeting colon GLUT receptors. The synthesized compounds were characterized using various spectroscopic and physicochemical techniques, including elemental analysis, UV - Vis, FT - IR, TGA, SEM, molar conductance, and magnetic susceptibility. The Schiff base acted as a bidentate ligand through azomethinic N and phenolic O-atoms. Electronic spectra and magnetic measurements of the vanadyl complex indicated a square pyramidal geometry. The SEM image of the VO(II) complex reveals a cauliflower-like, highly porous morphology, with particle sizes averaging 55-65 nm, indicating nanoscale features that may enhance its properties. Quantum chemical calculations, particularly the energy values of both CSSA and VO(II) chelate, further supported the proposed chelation process. DNA binding electrophoresis analysis demonstrated significant potential for both compounds. Both compounds revealed remarkable anticancer activities against the colorectal Caco-2 cell line, with IC(50) values of 13.26 +/- 0.03 for the CSSA ligand and 22.99 +/- 0.39 mug/ml for its VO(II) complex. However, the presence of quercetin as a GLUT inhibitor significantly increased the IC(50) of the CSSA ligand to 647.49 +/- 7.57 mug/ml. Therefore, sugar-conjugated compounds can be recognized by the glucose recognition binding site of GLUT, and their cell-killing effects depend highly on the GLUT inhibitor, quercetin. Molecular docking analysis was used to examine the compounds' potential for GLUT transportability. Furthermore, in vitro and molecular docking investigations on alpha-amylase inhibition were performed to assess the antidiabetic efficacy of the compounds. The VO(II) complex demonstrated stronger alpha-amylase inhibitory activity, with an IC(5)(0) value of 76.1 mug/ml, compared to the CSSA ligand, which showed an IC(5)(0) of 140.0 mug/ml. The inhibition zone values for both the ligand and its complex indicated strong antibacterial action, relative to the gentamycin standard antibacterial drug.
abstract_zh: 在我们对GLUT葡萄糖识别结合位点的持续研究以及提高靶向抗癌药物疗效的过程中，糖原化金属配合物已显示出通过水杨醛-d-葡萄糖部分治疗结肠癌的潜力。壳聚糖作为一种生物聚合物，是葡萄糖部分的来源。通过壳聚糖（CS）与水杨醛（SA）之间的缩合反应合成了席夫碱（CSSA），随后形成钒氧配合物[VO (CSSA)(2)]‧5H(2)O。这两种化合物均作为靶向结肠GLUT受体的核心。合成的化合物通过各种光谱和物理化学技术进行了表征，包括元素分析、紫外-可见光谱（UV-Vis）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FT-IR）、热重分析（TGA）、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、摩尔电导率和磁化率。席夫碱通过偶氮甲碱N原子和酚O原子充当双齿配体。钒氧配合物的电子光谱和磁性测量表明其具有四方锥几何构型。VO(II)配合物的SEM图像显示其具有花椰菜状、高度多孔的形态，平均粒径为55-65 nm，表明其纳米级特征可能增强其性能。量子化学计算，特别是CSSA和VO(II)螯合物的能量值，进一步支持了所提出的螯合过程。DNA结合电泳分析显示两种化合物均具有显著潜力。两种化合物对结直肠Caco-2细胞系表现出显著的抗癌活性，CSSA配体的IC(50)值为13.26 +/- 0.03，其VO(II)配合物的IC(50)值为22.99 +/- 0.39 μg/ml。然而，作为GLUT抑制剂的槲皮素的存在显著将CSSA配体的IC(50)提高至647.49 +/- 7.57 μg/ml。因此，糖缀合物可被GLUT的葡萄糖识别结合位点识别，其细胞杀伤效应高度依赖于GLUT抑制剂槲皮素。分子对接分析用于检查化合物在GLUT转运能力方面的潜力。此外，进行了α-淀粉酶抑制的体外和分子对接研究，以评估化合物的抗糖尿病功效。VO(II)配合物表现出更强的α-淀粉酶抑制活性，IC(5)(0)值为76.1 μg/ml，而CSSA配体的IC(5)(0)值为140.0 μg/ml。相对于庆大霉素标准抗菌药物，配体及其配合物的抑菌圈值表明其具有强抗菌作用。
